svg.title: Latency by service
svg.desc: Area chart of Density by Latency (ms), coloured by Service.

g.aria-label: X-axis titled 'Latency (ms)' for a linear scale with values from 20 to 240
Y-axis titled 'Density' for a linear scale with values from 0.000 to 0.016
Symbol legend titled 'Service' for fill color and stroke color with 3 values: A, B, C
